correctness.rationale: Read the final RESULT.md proof. Every admissible labeling belongs uniquely to neutral-minima phase of cardinality 3^b or to positive/negative-minima phases each of cardinality 2^a−1; opposite signs among minima contradict upward persistence and glut freedom. In each conditional phase independent binomial color populations tend to infinity, so q-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraisse games against one of three homogeneous countable reference structures determine every fixed-rank first-order sentence. Consequently phase-profile limits are precisely (1−w)epsilon_0+(w/2)(epsilon_++epsilon_-). The existential nonneutral-minimum sentence has exact probability w, giving the convergence converse. The homeomorphic logistic dependence on a−(log_2 3)b establishes the iff crossover. Irrational density of {n log_2 3} yields the critical cluster [1/2,2/3], and only constant binary phase profiles converge on it. Boundary conditions a,b→∞, fixed formula, exactly one atom, and sampling uniform over admissible labelings are essential.
